_comment: Documented stored-content debt accepted by the oldshape-audit gate. Every entry maps to the Track B casualty register (.claude/backups/2026-07-15-track-b/REGISTER.md, 2026-07-15). NEVER add a fresh casualty here instead of migrating it (scripts/wp-migrate-oldshape-blocks.js). CRITICAL: never raise the baseline silently — any increase must include a written reason (see check-element-manifest-conformance.js:796-798).

_meta.dispositionVocabularyNote: Closed vocabulary: by-design (correct, will never need fixing) / accepted-debt (real gap, consciously deferred) / detector-limitation (the checker itself is wrong — flags a rule violation per THE-MIGRATION-METHOD.md:455, not a normal outcome) / blocked (waiting on something external). See .claude/parking.md P-BASELINE-DISPOSITION-VOCABULARY / .claude/LEDGER.md.

_emptied.why: Zero accepted findings is CORRECT here, not a disabled gate. The 122 palestine-lives/* entries went when that deploy target was deleted (it was removed from build-deploy.py TARGETS on 2026-08-10, and findings are keyed by target name, so those keys can never be produced again). Of the 75 sandybrown entries, 60 were already stale and the remaining 15 were resolved by trashing the 8 spent development probe pages that carried them (773 container-cap-test, 1359 SGS Wave1 Box Test, 2334 T3 hero split probe, 2500 BP640 probe, and untitled drafts 820/823/824/2143). Six of those 15 were unknown-block findings for sgs/mobile-nav, sgs/mobile-nav-toggle and sgs/announcement-bar -- blocks deleted from the framework, so those pages could not be migrated, only removed.
_emptied.verified: Live re-audit of the canary after trashing: 416 posts, 21 findings, 0 NEW HIGH, 0 baselined. Pages were TRASHED not force-deleted, so they remain recoverable from WP Trash.
_emptied.ratchet: An empty baseline is the TIGHTEST setting: any new oldshape finding on the canary now fails the deploy instead of being silently accepted. Do not re-add an entry without a register reference and a reason.
